name: Amara
text_1:
Villa Amara offers a stunning family retreat, nestled amongst private beaches, pontoons, spacious driveways and a swimming lagoon on the serene Nareel Island in Abu Dhabi.
Designed with exquisite detail, this family home features a striking white limestone façade and an L-shaped layout that enhances both aesthetics and functionality.

Overhanging canopies shade the extensive slimline glazing, which opens fully to blend indoor and outdoor spaces seamlessly. This design choice encourages natural light while maintaining a connection to the lush tropical garden outside.
text_2: Inside, the villa has been designed for maximum comfort and elegance, starting with a spacious majlis at the entrance and a private family lounge that offers a cosy retreat with views of the garden. The first floor features two master suites, both facing the open sea, providing stunning vistas and a tranquil atmosphere throughout the home. This level is one of the villa’s standout features, cantilevering over the main overflow pool and providing shade from the Arabian sun while creating a captivating visual element.

The roof level further amplifies sea views, offering a breathtaking perspective of the vibrant city and its surroundings.

Villa Amara embodies the perfect balance of luxury and nature, making it an ideal sanctuary for a family living in a tranquil yet active neighbourhood on the coast in Al Bateen.
